svg.title: Artery cross-section with thrombosis
svg.desc: Cross-section through a muscular artery whose eccentric atherosclerotic plaque has ruptured at the shoulder of its fibrous cap: an occluding thrombus of platelet-fibrin and red-cell-rich layers fills the lumen and enters the lipid core through the tear.
